title: Imperial Envoys
next_chapter_hook: The Imperial Envoys left in狼狈, but Chen Ji knew this was only the prelude to a greater storm—the aura of the Tianji Record had already been exposed, and more dangerous existences were watching from the shadows.

text.content: In the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the morning mist had yet to disperse. A team of envoys in dark gold embroidered robes stood in formation before the hall, the leader holding an Imperial Decree aloft, proudly standing beneath the jade steps. Han Lie stood in the crowd, his gaze complex as he watched it all—only yesterday had he crossed blades with Chen Ji, yet now he was watching this spectacle.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself) What is thistrash planning...

text.content: Chen Ji slowly walked out from the side hall, dressed in plain white disciple robes, his expression so calm as to appear wooden. His "death" had already spread throughout the sect. Now appearing as this "resurrected" form, outsiders saw only a bizarre near-death phenomenon. Those Imperial Envoys clearly didn't understand the intricacies—they thought him merely a dying man.

dialogue.content: (Slightly cupping his hands) Envoys, you've traveled far. Chen Ji failed to welcome you properly.

text.content: The Imperial Envoy coldly snorted, raising the dark gold banner high. Dazzling golden light exploded through the hall. "Chen Ji, you're nothing but atrash, and occupying the position of Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince is an insult to the throne! By imperial decree today—hand over the Tianji Record Fragment, and we'll grant you a whole corpse!" His voice rang like metal striking stone, filled with arrogance.

dialogue.content: (Softly laughing) Grant me a whole corpse? What grand authority you hold, Envoy. I only wonder—whose decree is this, precisely?

text.content: The Envoy's smile froze for an instant, then regained its arrogance. "What need have you, a dying man, to ask such questions? The Tianji Record is an ancient forbidden artifact—how dare you covet it! Hand it over quickly, and we may yet preserve what little face your Chen family has left." His gaze swept across everyone in the hall, full of disdain.

choice.prompt: Faced with the Imperial Envoy's threats, Chen Ji chooses:

choices.text: Expose and humiliate on the spot
choices.description: Directly reveal the secret dealings between the envoy and the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, humiliating him publicly
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from higher powers

text.content: Chen Ji leisurely straightened his sleeves, a meaningful smile playing at the corner of his mouth. "The secret dealings you speak of, Envoy—were they your meeting with the Third Protector of the Holy Sect in Youzhou last year? Or is that 'special guest' at your residence still recovering from injuries?"

dialogue.content: (Voice suddenly turning ice-cold) If I truly were merely a dying man, why would you be so urgent, Envoy?

choices.description: Use the official Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince status to refute—the envoy has no authority to enforce law within sect territory
choices.visible_reward: The envoy is caught between a rock and a hard place
choices.risk_hint: May be investigated by higher authorities later

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze calmly sweeping over that dark gold banner. "The position of Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince was personally bestowed by His Majesty. Does the Envoy hold the same imperial decree? Without equivalent authority, this banner in the Tianqing Sect... is nothing but scrap iron."

dialogue.content: (Slight smile) If you wish to enforce law here, perhaps you should first greet the elders of Tianqing Sect?

choices.description: Display a minor use of foresight ability, making the envoy realize he's not someone to provoke
choices.risk_hint: Exposing abilities may invite greater coveting

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, a point of dim light glowing at his fingertip. "In three breaths, the Envoy will sneeze. In five breaths, the second person on your left behind you will miss a step. In seven breaths..." He paused, "a crack will appear in the Jade Pendant at your waist."

dialogue.content: (Withdrawing his hand) Now you understand the use of the Tianji Record, Envoy?

text.content: Silence fell over the hall. The envoy's face instantly turned deathly pale. He instinctively touched the Jade Pendant at his waist—that precious warm jade worth a thousand gold—had somehow already developed a thin crack. "You... this is witchcraft!" His voice trembled, yet he no longer had any of his earlier confidence.

dialogue.content: (Inhaling sharply, murmuring) Thistrash... how did he do that?

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze like an ancient well—unfathomable. "Witchcraft? The Tianji Record is an ancient supreme treasure, capable of窥见 three hours of heavenly secrets. You asked why I dare occupy this position—now do you understand? Not daring to covet it—I am worthy of it." His voice was not loud, yet every word cut like a blade.

dialogue.content: (Stepping forward slowly) As for the noble behind you... I suggest you go back and relay a message. The Tianji Record chooses its master never asking of birth or status. If he insists on taking it... I'd like to see how many lives he has to gamble with.

choice.prompt: The envoy retreated in狼狈, Chen Ji decides:

choices.description: Apply further pressure to force the envoy to reveal the identity of the mastermind

text.content: Chen Ji stepped closer again. The envoy retreated continuously until his back pressed against the jade steps. "Why don't you tell me, who sent you to wade into this muddy water? Chen Ji has a good memory—I'll make sure to pay them a visit someday." His smile didn't reach his eyes.

choices.description: Let the envoy leave, but leave a meaningful warning behind
choices.visible_reward: Plant a hidden chess piece in the imperial court

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stepped back, standing with hands behind his back. "Enough. The Envoy has traveled far. Chen Ji is not one to ignore proper etiquette. Today's matter—we'll consider it a lesson for you. Go back and tell your master—while the Tianji Record remains in my hands for one more day, it remains something he cannot covet."

The envoy scrambled out of the hall, not even bothering to take the dark gold banner. Laughter erupted throughout. Those disciples who had previously looked down on Chen Ji exchanged glances, their gazes now carrying a说不清道不明的 reverence.

dialogue.content: (Grinding his teeth, murmuring) Playing dumb to eat the tiger... always this trick!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, his gaze casually sweeping over Han Lie. In that moment of eye contact, Han Lie felt a bone-deep chill—this "trash's" eyes were clearly filled with disdain. Not disdain for the envoy, but for everyone present.

choice.prompt: Just as Han Lie was about to step forward and confront him, Chen Ji:

choices.description: Walk past Han Lie like he's looking at air—total ignorance is more humiliating than any mockery
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may cause a scene on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji didn't even glance at Han Lie again. He simply straightened his sleeves and slowly walked toward the side hall. His retreating figure gradually faded from everyone's view, leaving behind a hall of silence and Han Lie's ashen face.

choices.text: Make a cutting remark before leaving
choices.description: Drop a casual sentence before leaving, completely igniting Han Lie's fury
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie will target him even more later

dialogue.content: (Not slowing his pace) Senior Han, I accepted your guidance during our last sparring. When time permits, I'll seek your instruction again—don't worry, I won't use the Tianji Record.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's ability to give Han Lie a "friendly reminder," leaving him sleepless
choices.visible_cost: Consume another 5 points of Heavenly Fate

dialogue.content: (Stopping and turning his head) Senior Han, within three days, don't go to the Rear Mountain Forbidden Grounds. If you do... remember to bring enough healing elixirs.

text.content: Outside the hall, the morning mist gradually cleared. Sunlight fell upon the peak of Tianqing. The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the hall, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly—today's game, he had won beautifully. Yet within that smile, a trace of solemnity flickered in his eyes. The aura of the Tianji Record had, after all, been exposed. That existence watching from the shadows had probably already sensed something.

He mentally calculated: another ten points of Heavenly Fate consumed, leaving less than a hundred days remaining. The next time he used the Tianji Record, he would have to be even more cautious. And that so-called "imperial noble" was clearly merely a chess piece on stage—the real game was just beginning.

dialogue.content: (An elderly voice echoed from the Tianji Record Fragment) Well done, but your time is running out. Behind the imperial court stands more than just mortals.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond. He only looked up at the horizon. In the clouds above, as if an无形 eye was watching him. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—the ultimate great enemy—was it also secretly observing every move he made? The wind blew across Tianqing Peak, carrying away the envoy's狼狈 footsteps, but it could not dispel the mounting pressure permeating the air.

Today's battle, he had shown everyone—Chen Ji is not atrash. Only they didn't know how many moves he had already calculated behind this "performance." The Imperial Envoys left in狼狈, but Chen Ji knew this was only the prelude to a greater storm—the aura of the Tianji Record had already been exposed, and more dangerous existences were watching from the shadows.

And somewhere in the invisible Void, an existence beyond human comprehension shuddered slightly. The tendrils of the Heavenly Dao's Eye were quietly reaching toward this ant who dared challenge its chess game. The gears of fate had begun to turn.
